jurisdiction.name: Marshall Islands
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: The Marshall Islands has no AI-specific law, strategy or guidance. Its 2025 package of digital laws, including a Personal Data Protection Act for government bodies and a Cybersecurity Act, is the only relevant framework, but their official texts could not be read.
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 13 October 2026, but Parliament's legislation portal blocks automated access and the banking commission's and health ministry's websites could not be accessed, so no official document could be read. The Marshall Islands is marked for a later retry. The 2025 Personal Data Protection Act and Cybersecurity Act are tracked as leads.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-13, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. rmiparliament.org captcha/403 (curl and WebFetch); Banking Commission and Ministry of Health sites rejected by egress proxy; ntamar.net parked; rmigovernment.org hosts unrelated content. PDPA 2025 (P.L. 2025-43) official PDF URL recorded in lead; only PacLII bill copy readable (not official); certification date unconfirmed, so lead not located-only record. Digital Transformation and Identity Verification Act 2025, Electronic Transactions Act 2025: not AI-related. Convention 108: not a party. Units covered: Law: Searched for AI laws, AI provisions, deepfake/cybercrime and AI bills: none found. The 2025 digital-law package (Personal Data Protection Act 2025, Cybersecurity Act 2025, Digital Transformation and Identity Verification Act 2025, Electronic Transactions Act 2025) was identified, but the Nitijela legislation portal (rmiparliament.org) returned a captcha/403 to curl and WebFetch, so no official text could be read; PDPA and Cybersecurity Act held as leads.; Government: Searched for a national AI strategy, digital/ICT strategy with an AI pillar, public-sector AI/GenAI guidelines and Digital Transformation Unit documents: searched, nothing found. No official national AI strategy or policy located; the Digital RMI programme is a World Bank project (not a national AI instrument).; Ministries: Education (Public School System), health, justice, finance, transport/communications/IT: searched, nothing found on AI. Several ministry domains were unreachable or parked; rmigovernment.org now hosts unrelated content.; Regulators: No data protection authority yet operating (EPSSO reportedly designated under the PDPA, unverified); National Telecommunications Authority domain ntamar.net is parked; Banking Commission site unreachable. Searched, nothing found on AI.. Not reached: rmiparliament.org (Nitijela legislation portal and gazette texts): captcha/403 to curl and WebFetch; Banking Commission and Ministry of Health websites: connection refused through egress proxy. leads.title: Personal Data Protection Act 2025 (P.L. 2025-43)
leads.issuing_authority: Nitijela (Parliament) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
leads.note: General data protection law for personal data processed by core government ministries and agencies (data-privacy category once verified). Official enacted text is listed by the Nitijela at https://rmiparliament.org/cms/images/LEGISLATION/PRINCIPAL/2025/2025-0043/2025-0043_1.pdf (public laws 2025 index: https://rmiparliament.org/cms/library/public-laws-by-years/60-2025.html), but on 2026-10-13 the Nitijela site returned only a captcha/403 page to both curl and WebFetch, so the text, certification date and commencement could not be read. A bill copy exists on PacLII (pacliirms.paclii.org, not an official host). Secondary sources report the Economic Policy, Planning and Statistics Office (EPSSO) as competent authority and effect twelve months after certification (s.418); unverified. Re-check the official PDF: record as binding_law / data-privacy with the certification date, and check for any automated-decision or profiling provisions.

leads.title: Cybersecurity Act 2025
leads.issuing_authority: Nitijela (Parliament) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
leads.note: General cybersecurity framework law of the 2025 digital-law package (with the Digital Transformation and Identity Verification Act 2025 and the Electronic Transactions Act 2025). Official text on rmiparliament.org could not be reached on 2026-10-13 (captcha/403); only a PacLII bill copy was discoverable. Not AI-specific as far as known; check the official text for any AI provisions before recording.
